name: jet_approach
text: A large passenger jet airliner flying past overhead on its approach to land, a steady deep turbofan roar and low rumble, heard from the ground outdoors, continuous, no doppler sweep

name: jet_climb
text: A large passenger jet airliner climbing out after takeoff, powerful jet engine roar with a high turbofan whine on top, heard from the ground outdoors, continuous, no doppler sweep

name: suspended_train
text: A suspended monorail train gliding along an overhead steel rail, smooth electric motor hum, soft rhythmic clicks of the wheels over rail joints, gentle sway creaks, continuous

name: station_chime
text: A gentle three-note electronic chime at a train station announcing a departure, clean and bright, short

name: souk_arcade
text: A busy covered Arabian market arcade at night, indoor crowd murmur and chatter, footsteps on stone floors, shopkeepers calling softly, cups clinking, faint oud music from a shop, reverberant hall, continuous

name: crowd_cheer_1
text: An excited crowd of spectators lining a street race at night bursts into cheers and whistles as the racers go past, short and lively, outdoors, no engine sounds

name: crowd_cheer_2
text: A grandstand crowd roars and applauds, a rising cheer that settles, outdoor night race, no vehicles

name: crowd_cheer_3
text: Spectators behind barriers clapping, shouting and whooping as racers speed by, a couple of air horns, outdoors, no engines

name: crowd_cheer_4
text: A seaside promenade crowd cheering loudly, whistles and shouts of encouragement, a short burst, no engines

name: crowd_cheer_5
text: A crowd gasps and then erupts into excited cheering and applause, outdoors at night, no vehicles

name: crowd_cheer_6
text: Festive fans cheering and clapping along to a darbuka drum, whistles, a short joyful burst, outdoors at night, no engines

name: suspended_train_run
text: A suspended monorail train running along an overhead steel girder track, a deep metallic rumble of steel wheels on the rail, the girder resonating and humming, an electric motor whine, continuous

name: suspended_passby_1
text: A suspended railway train passes close overhead: a rising rumble and squeal of steel wheels on the rail, the steel girder booming as it goes by, then fading away into the distance, no horn, no voices

name: suspended_passby_2
text: An overhead hanging monorail train rushes past above the street, rattling steel wheels and a booming girder swelling and then fading away, no horn, no voices

name: suspended_brakes
text: An electric train braking smoothly to a stop at an elevated station, a soft brake squeal and a hiss of air, short

name: rolling_mill
text: Inside a huge steel rolling mill hall, a deep industrial hum, heavy rollers turning, a hot steel slab grinding through the mill stands with rumbling and occasional metallic clanks and booms echoing in the big hall, steam hiss, continuous

name: blast_furnace
text: A blast furnace at a steelworks heard from outside nearby, a deep steady roar of hot air blowing, low rumbling, distant industrial machinery, continuous

name: church_bells
text: Large bronze church bells ringing from a stone church tower in a small German town, several bells pealing together, heard from the market square, natural reverb

name: crane_horn
text: An overhead travelling crane warning horn in a factory hall, two short electric horn honks echoing

name: barge_engine
text: A large inland cargo barge on a canal, a slow heavy diesel engine thumping, water churning at the stern, heard from the canal bank, continuous

name: rhein_ship_horn
text: A large inland cargo ship's horn on a wide river, one long deep blast that echoes across the water and fades, heard from the river bank

name: rhein_ship_horn2
text: Two short deep blasts of a river cargo ship's horn on a wide river, echoing across the water

name: rhein_ship_engine
text: A large river cargo ship passing slowly, a deep diesel engine throbbing and water rushing along its hull, heard from the river bank, continuous

name: autobahn_hum
text: Motorway traffic heard from a meadow beside it: a steady hum of tyres, cars and lorries swooshing past in both directions, continuous, no horns

name: kirmes_fair
text: A German fun fair heard from across a meadow: a cheerful fairground organ playing an instrumental tune, rides whirring and clanking, a bell ringing, people laughing and a crowd murmuring without clear words, continuous

name: sheep_bleat_1
text: A single sheep bleating once in a meadow, close

name: sheep_bleat_2
text: A lamb bleating twice in a field, close

name: sheep_bleat_3
text: An old ewe giving a low hoarse bleat in a pasture, close

name: sheep_flock
text: A flock of sheep grazing on a river dyke: soft bleats here and there, hooves on grass, a bell on one sheep, continuous

name: river_lap
text: A wide fast river flowing past a pebble beach and stone groynes: water lapping and gurgling against the stones, gentle and continuous

name: windmill_turn
text: An old wooden tower windmill turning slowly in a steady wind: the sails whooshing past, wooden gears creaking and knocking, continuous

name: quench_burst
text: A coking plant's quench tower: water floods a car of red-hot coke, a huge roaring hiss of steam rising into the air, then slowly dying away, heard from a road nearby

name: kokerei_hum
text: A working coking plant heard from beside it: a low industrial hum, steam hissing from pipes, heavy machinery clanking now and then, a distant rumble, continuous

name: crows_morning
text: Crows and jackdaws calling in birch trees on a quiet misty summer morning, a few caws here and there, soft wind, continuous

name: conveyor_rattle
text: An old coal conveyor belt running high up in a steel gallery: rollers rattling and squeaking, coal rumbling along, continuous

name: sr_tram_bell_1
text: A modern German city tram's warning gong: two quick bright metallic dings, outdoors on a street

name: sr_tram_bell_2
text: A city tram driver ringing the tram's warning bell three times urgently, bright metallic gong, outdoors

name: sr_car_horn_1
text: A small European hatchback car honking its horn once, short and annoyed, outdoors on a city street

name: sr_car_horn_2
text: An angry driver leaning on the car horn, a long continuous honk then two short ones, city street

name: sr_car_horn_3
text: A city bus or delivery truck sounding its deep horn, one long blast, city street

name: sr_tram_pass
text: A modern low-floor tram rolling along a city street: electric motor whine, steel wheels on grooved rails, soft rumble and clicks over rail joints, continuous

name: sr_ring_traffic
text: Busy four-lane city ring road traffic heard from the pavement: cars, vans and buses passing continuously at fifty kilometres an hour, tyre noise and engines, no horns, continuous

name: sr_ball_crash_1
text: A heavy steel wrecking ball smashing into a concrete building wall: a huge crash, concrete cracking and crumbling, rubble and debris falling, dust

name: sr_ball_crash_2
text: A demolition wrecking ball hitting a reinforced concrete facade: deep booming impact, glass and concrete shattering, chunks tumbling down

name: sr_ball_clang
text: A heavy swinging steel wrecking ball hitting a small car: a loud metallic clang and a crunch of bent metal

name: sr_ball_whoosh
text: A huge steel wrecking ball on a chain swinging past close by: a deep heavy whoosh of air and the rattle of the steel chain

name: sr_handler
text: A scrapyard material handler crane slewing: diesel engine revving under load and a whining hydraulic pump, steel creaking, continuous

name: sr_magnet_clang
text: Heavy scrap metal clanging: a crushed car swinging on a crane magnet bangs into steel, loud metallic clang and rattle

name: sr_excavator
text: A large tracked excavator working on a building site: diesel engine under load, hydraulic arm whine, the bucket scraping soil, continuous

name: sr_roller
text: A vibratory road roller compacting a gravel road: diesel engine and a deep rhythmic thrumming drum vibration, continuous

name: sr_beeper
text: A construction vehicle's reversing alarm: a steady electronic beep beep beep, continuous

name: sr_site
text: A busy construction site in a city: distant hammering, a circular saw now and then, a concrete mixer turning, machines rumbling, workers' tools clanking, continuous

name: sr_scrapyard
text: A scrapyard at work: scrap metal being dropped and clattering onto piles, a crane's engine, steel creaking and banging, continuous

name: shield_up
text: A futuristic energy force field powering up around a small vehicle: a rising electric whoosh that blooms into a bright shimmering hum, sci-fi arcade game power-up, clean, short

name: shield_down
text: A futuristic energy force field running out and fading away: a few stuttering electric flickers then a falling soft power-down whoosh, sci-fi arcade game, clean, short

name: shield_break
text: A futuristic energy shield shattering when hit: a sharp crackling electric burst with a glassy crystalline shatter and a quick fizzle, sci-fi arcade game, punchy, short

name: puddle_splash_1
text: A small toy car driving fast through a shallow rain puddle on a road, a short light watery splash and spray, close up, outdoors, no engine

name: puddle_splash_2
text: A car tyre rolling quickly through a shallow muddy puddle, a brief soft swish of splashing water, close up, outdoors, no engine

name: ab_car_petrol
text: A modern petrol family car cruising at steady motorway speed, engine hum and tyre roar on asphalt, recorded close beside the car moving along with it, constant pitch, no passing, no doppler, no wind gusts

name: ab_suv_v6
text: A large SUV with a V6 petrol engine cruising at steady motorway speed, a deeper throaty engine note and wide tyres humming on asphalt, recorded close alongside, constant pitch, no doppler, no passing

name: ab_van_diesel
text: A diesel delivery van cruising at steady motorway speed, clattering diesel engine drone and tyre noise, recorded close alongside, constant pitch, no doppler, no passing

name: ab_motorhome
text: A heavy motorhome camper on a truck chassis cruising on the motorway, low turbo diesel rumble, rattling body, big tyres on asphalt, recorded close alongside, constant pitch, no doppler, no passing

name: ab_horn_long
text: An angry long car horn blast on a motorway, a single sustained honk about one second long, clear, close

name: ab_horn_truck
text: A deep loud two-tone horn of a motorhome or small truck, two short honks, close, outdoors

name: city_car
text: A small petrol hatchback driving through a city street at about 40 km/h, light engine hum in a middle gear, tyres on asphalt, recorded close alongside, steady, no passing, no doppler, no horn

name: city_suv
text: A family SUV rolling along a busy city street at moderate speed, a soft engine note and an easy gear change, tyres on asphalt, recorded close alongside, steady, no passing, no doppler

name: city_van
text: A diesel delivery van driving slowly through town traffic, rattling diesel at low revs, a gear change, recorded close alongside, steady, no passing, no doppler

name: city_bus
text: A city bus driving along a street at low speed, deep diesel drone, air brakes hiss softly once, heavy tyres, recorded close alongside, steady, no passing, no doppler

name: lightplane_engine
text: A small single-engine four-seat propeller aeroplane cruising overhead, the steady buzzing drone of a four-cylinder piston engine and propeller heard from the ground, continuous, constant pitch, no doppler sweep, no wind gusts

name: engine_bootlegger
text: A supercharged big-block V8 hot rod engine held at a steady mid-high RPM, deep loud lumpy rumble from open exhaust headers with the high mechanical whine of a roots supercharger on top, recorded close, constant engine speed, no revving, no gear changes, continuous drone

name: engine_meteor
text: A vintage 1930s supercharged straight-eight Grand Prix racing car engine held at a steady high RPM, raw metallic exhaust bark with a shrill screaming supercharger wail, open pipes, recorded close, constant engine speed, no revving, no gear changes, continuous drone

name: engine_bubble
text: A tiny 1950s single-cylinder two-stroke microcar engine held at a steady high RPM, buzzy rattly ring-ding-ding putter like a moped, tinny exhaust, recorded close, constant engine speed, no revving, continuous drone
